meaning: n. 戰鬥；戰役 v. 與……戰鬥
example: The long battle for control of the coastal city lasted almost three weeks. (爭奪這座沿海城市控制權的漫長戰役持續了將近三週。)

meaning: v. 掙扎；奮鬥 n. 掙扎；奮鬥

meaning: v. 轟炸；轟擊；連珠炮般質問
example: Reporters bombarded the minister with questions about the sudden resignation of her senior deputy. (記者連珠炮般追問部長，她的高階副手為何突然辭職。)

meaning: n. 炸彈 v. 轟炸
example: The bomb was discovered in a parked car near the station and safely removed. (這枚炸彈在車站附近一輛停放的車內被發現，隨後被安全移除。)

meaning: v. 閃爍；閃耀 n. 閃爍
example: The lights of the distant fishing village twinkled brightly across the dark water. (遠處漁村的燈火在漆黑的水面上明亮閃爍。)
Gunpowder was invented in China and later changed the nature of warfare entirely. (火藥在中國發明，後來徹底改變了戰爭的性質。)
The old water tank on the roof still supplies the whole apartment building. (屋頂上的舊水箱仍供應整棟公寓的用水。)
The police officer carried a pistol but hoped he would never need to use it. (這名警察配帶手槍，但希望永遠不必用到它。)
The young soldier cleaned his rifle carefully before setting out on the night patrol. (年輕士兵在出發夜巡前仔細擦拭步槍。)

meaning: n. 閃光；閃光訊號燈 v. 閃耀；突然燒旺
example: A red distress flare suddenly lit the dark sky above the sinking fishing boat. (一枚紅色求救閃光訊號燈突然照亮沉沒漁船上方的夜空。)

meaning: v. 發出微弱穩定的光 n. 微弱穩定的光；光輝
example: The old street lamps gave a warm golden glow to the narrow stone street. (老路燈為狹窄的石板街道灑下溫暖的金色光暈。)
The ancient sword is displayed in a locked glass case in the local museum. (這把古劍陳列在當地博物館一個上鎖的玻璃櫃裡。)
He split the dry logs with a heavy ax before the winter arrived. (冬天來臨前，他用沉重的斧頭劈開乾木柴。)

meaning: n. 錘；榔頭 v. 用錘擊；敲打
example: She used a small hammer to fix the loose wooden board on the fence. (她用一把小錘子固定柵欄上鬆動的木板。)
A large red arrow on the sign points clearly towards the main station entrance. (標誌上一個大紅箭頭清楚指向車站的主要入口。)

meaning: n. 矛；標槍 v. 用尖物刺穿

All cyclists should wear a helmet that fits properly and meets current safety standards. (所有騎腳踏車的人都應戴合適且符合現行安全標準的安全帽。)

meaning: n. 盾；防護物 v. 保護；掩護
example: A heavy metal shield protected the young soldier's chest throughout the fierce battle. (一面沉重的金屬盾在激烈的戰役中全程保護著年輕士兵的胸口。)
The school now provides free hot meals for children from the poorest local families. (這所學校現在為當地最貧困家庭的孩子提供免費熱餐。)

meaning: v. 打；擊；碰撞 n. 打擊；命中
example: The storm hit the coast on Friday night and brought down many trees. (暴風雨在星期五晚上侵襲海岸，吹倒了許多樹木。)

meaning: v. 打；打敗；跳動 n. 節拍；擊鼓聲
example: Our team beat the visiting side by two goals in the final minute. (我們隊在最後一分鐘以兩球之差擊敗客隊。)
Chop the dry wood into small pieces so that it burns more easily. (把乾木頭劈成小塊，這樣比較容易燃燒。)
The council faces a dilemma between building new homes and protecting green space. (市議會面臨兩難：究竟該興建新住宅，還是保護綠地。)
The documentary highlights the plight of thousands of families living in temporary shelters. (這部紀錄片凸顯數千個住在臨時收容所家庭的困境。)
The most common pitfall is to spend far too little time planning the project. (最常見的陷阱，就是花太少的時間規劃這項計畫。)
Two officials were accused of a conspiracy to hide the true cost of the project. (兩名官員被控密謀隱匿這項計畫的真實成本。)

meaning: adj. 赤貧的；一無所有的；缺乏的
example: The flood left thousands of local families completely destitute and dependent on emergency aid. (洪水讓數千個當地家庭一無所有，只能依賴緊急援助。)
Severe famine followed the long drought, and international agencies sent emergency food supplies. (長期乾旱之後發生嚴重飢荒，國際機構送來緊急糧食援助。)
Customs officers seized the illegal goods at the border and started an investigation. (海關人員在邊境查扣非法貨物，並展開調查。)
She decided to pursue a career in environmental law after finishing her degree. (她取得學位後，決定從事環境法相關職業。)
Rising sea levels pose a serious long-term threat to many low-lying coastal towns. (海平面上升對許多低窪沿海城鎮構成嚴重的長期威脅。)
Journalists should never intrude on the private grief of ordinary families in deep mourning. (記者絕不應侵擾正沉浸在悲痛中的普通家庭。)
The old walled city remained under siege for more than six long, difficult months. (這座有城牆的古城被圍攻超過六個漫長而艱難的月份。)

meaning: n. 暫停；停頓 v. 暫停；停頓
example: After a short pause, she continued reading aloud from the final page of the report. (短暫停頓後，她繼續朗讀報告的最後一頁。)
The military regime oppressed its own citizens for decades before it finally collapsed in 1989. (這個軍事政權壓迫本國人民數十年，直到一九八九年終於瓦解。)
The hospital rules strictly forbid visitors from smoking inside the main buildings or wards. (醫院規定嚴格禁止訪客在主建築或病房內吸菸。)
Regular and careful hand washing helps prevent the spread of infection in crowded city hospitals. (規律且仔細洗手有助預防感染在擁擠的城市醫院中擴散。)

meaning: n. 叛亂；反抗 v. 叛亂；反抗
example: The violent revolt began after the government sharply raised the price of bread and fuel. (政府大幅調漲麵包和燃料價格後，爆發了暴力叛亂。)
He was charged with treason after passing military secrets to a foreign government. (他因把軍事機密交給外國政府而被控叛國罪。)

meaning: n. 反叛者；叛逆者 v. 造反；反抗
example: The rebels controlled the remote northern hills for several years during the long civil war. (漫長的內戰期間，反叛者控制北部偏遠山區好幾年。)
He was branded a traitor for revealing the secret defence plan to the enemy. (他因把秘密國防計畫洩露給敵方而被指為叛徒。)
She described herself as a patriot who simply wanted to improve living conditions in her country. (她說自己是愛國者，只是想改善國內的生活條件。)

meaning: n. 責備；指責 v. 責備；指責
example: He looked at her with quiet, angry reproach, though he said nothing at all. (他帶著壓抑而憤怒的責備眼神看著她，卻一句話也沒說。)
The villagers fled in sheer terror when the heavy fighting finally reached their valley. (激烈戰事終於逼近村莊所在的山谷時，村民驚恐萬分地逃離。)

meaning: adj. 可怕的；糟糕的；極嚴重的
example: The road accident had terrible long-term consequences for the family and the entire community. (這起道路事故對那個家庭和整個社區造成極嚴重的長期後果。)

meaning: adj. 極好的；很大的；很強的
example: She did a terrific job of organising the whole international conference at short notice. (她在臨時通知的情況下，把整場國際會議籌辦得非常好。)
The smell from the kitchen drains was horrible, so we closed all the windows. (廚房排水孔傳來的味道很可怕，所以我們把窗戶全關了。)

meaning: v. 極為害怕；非常擔心 n. 恐懼；憂愁

The sudden loud noise frightened the horses and sent them running across the field. (突然的巨大聲響讓馬匹受驚，奔過整片田野。)
Tension between the two neighbouring communities rose sharply after the disputed election result. (選舉結果引發爭議後，兩個鄰近社區之間的緊張急遽升高。)

meaning: adj. 動盪的；混亂的；洶湧的

The country was thrown into turmoil by the sudden death of its leader. (領導人突然去世，讓這個國家陷入混亂。)

meaning: n. 情況；劇情梗概；腳本
example: The report outlines a worst-case scenario in which energy prices double within a single year. (報告勾勒出最壞情況：能源價格在一年內翻倍。)

meaning: n. 限度；界限 v. 限制；限定
example: The doctor advised him to limit the amount of salt in his diet. (醫師建議他限制飲食中的鹽分攝取量。)

meaning: n. 韁繩；控制權 v. 用韁繩勒馬；管束
example: The government took steps to rein in rising public spending after the crisis. (危機過後，政府採取措施管束不斷上升的公共支出。)

meaning: v. 爭取；爭辯 n. 競爭；比賽
example: The party will contest the seat at the next general election in May. (這個政黨將在五月的大選中爭取這個席次。)
Critics contend that the new law will seriously harm many already struggling small local businesses. (批評者主張，這項新法將嚴重傷害許多已苦苦掙扎的當地小型企業。)
Each competitor must complete the difficult uphill course within three hours to qualify. (每位參賽者必須在三小時內完成這段艱難的上坡路線才能取得資格。)
The two countries remained enemy states for decades before signing a peace treaty. (這兩個國家敵對數十年，後來才簽署和平條約。)
The company's aggressive tactic of cutting prices forced smaller rivals out of business. (這家公司積極削價的策略迫使較小的對手退出市場。)

meaning: n. 策略；技巧；軍事演習
example: The driver made a sharp maneuver to avoid a dog running onto the road. (駕駛緊急變換方向，避開一隻衝上馬路的狗。)
Officials warned local residents to stay indoors during the worst of the storm. (官員警告當地居民在暴風雨最猛烈的時候留在室內。)
The contract obliges the company to repair any damage within thirty working days. (合約迫使該公司必須在三十個工作天內修復任何損壞。)

meaning: n. 抗議；申明 v. 抗議；申辯
example: Thousands of workers joined the protest against the planned closure of the plant. (數千名工人參加抗議，反對計劃關閉這座工廠。)
The scientist firmly refuted the claim with evidence from three large independent studies published recently. (這位科學家以近期發表的三項大型獨立研究證據，堅決駁斥那項說法。)
The country used its full military might to end the long border dispute quickly. (這個國家動用全部軍事力量，想迅速結束長期的邊界爭端。)
Planting trees along rivers can mitigate the effects of flooding in low-lying areas. (在河邊種樹可以減輕低窪地區淹水的影響。)

meaning: n. 安慰；舒適 v. 安慰；撫慰
example: She found comfort in the letters her friends sent during that difficult year. (在那個艱難的一年裡，她從朋友寄來的信件中得到安慰。)

meaning: n. 事情；物質 v. 要緊
example: It does not matter whether you start today or tomorrow, as long as you start. (你今天或明天開始都不要緊，只要真的開始就好。)
No one yet knows exactly what happened on the night of the terrible bridge collapse. (目前還沒有人確切知道那座橋嚴重坍塌當晚發生了什麼事。)

meaning: adj. 野蠻的；兇狠的 n. 野蠻人 v. 兇狠地攻擊
example: The report describes the savage and cruel treatment of political prisoners in the remote camp. (報告描述政治犯在偏遠營地遭受兇狠殘酷的對待。)

meaning: adj. 魯莽的；不計後果的

meaning: n. 邪惡；禍害 adj. 邪惡的

The old folk story describes a dangerous bargain between a poor farmer and the devil. (這則古老民間故事描述一名貧農與魔鬼之間的危險交易。)
The punishment for the offence was a large fine and a short prison term. (這項罪行的懲罰是鉅額罰款和短期徒刑。)
Hundreds of local people attended the funeral of the much respected former town mayor. (數百名當地民眾參加了深受敬重的前任市長葬禮。)

meaning: n. 墳墓；死亡 adj. 莊重的；嚴肅的
example: A simple wooden cross today marks the quiet grave beside the old stone church. (如今一座簡單的木十字架標示著老石造教堂旁那座安靜的墳墓。)
The tomb of the famous poet is visited by thousands of readers each year. (這位名詩人的墳墓每年有數千名讀者前來憑弔。)
The former prisoners later described the labour camp as a living hell on earth. (這些前囚犯後來形容那座勞改營是人間活地獄。)
The naval base was originally built to protect the narrow entrance to the harbour. (這座海軍基地最初是為了保護港口狹窄的入口而建。)

meaning: n. 一群；軍隊 v. 結隊前行

meaning: n. 前進；進步 v. 前進；進步

meaning: n. 危險；風險 v. 冒著……的危險

The young sailors ignored the obvious peril of sailing in such extremely rough weather. (年輕水手忽視了在如此惡劣天候下航行的明顯重大危險。)

meaning: n. 拷問；折磨 v. 拷問；使痛苦

Some chemical additives in processed food may be harmful to the health of young children. (加工食品中的某些化學添加物可能有害幼童健康。)

meaning: v. 誤導；欺騙；使誤入歧途
example: The advertisement was banned because it deliberately misled customers about the product's supposed health benefits. (這則廣告因刻意誤導消費者相信產品具有健康效益而被禁播。)

meaning: n. 撤退；退避 v. 撤退；退避
example: The army was forced to retreat across the river after several days of heavy fighting. (經過數日激戰，軍隊被迫渡河撤退。)

meaning: n. 投降；放棄 v. 投降；放棄
example: The rebels refused to surrender even when their food and water supplies ran out. (即使糧食和飲水耗盡，反叛者仍拒絕投降。)

meaning: n. 逃跑；逃脫 v. 逃跑；逃避
example: Two prisoners escaped through a tunnel that they had dug over several long months. (兩名囚犯經由他們花了好幾個月挖成的隧道逃走。)

meaning: v. 放棄；停止；辭去；離開
example: He decided to quit his job and start a small business at home. (他決定辭掉工作，在家裡經營小生意。)
She decided to forgo her holiday in order to finish the project on time. (為了準時完成計畫，她決定放棄假期。)
The city is trying to get rid of its oldest and most polluting diesel buses. (這座城市正努力淘汰最老舊、汙染最嚴重的柴油公車。)
Lawyers defended in court the right of local residents to challenge the planning decision. (律師在法庭上為當地居民質疑這項都市計畫決定的權利辯護。)

meaning: v. 保護；保衛 n. 保護措施
example: Strict new rules were introduced to safeguard the personal data held by large online companies. (當局訂立嚴格的新規定，以保護大型網路公司持有的個人資料。)
The surprise election victory gave the party a clear majority in the national parliament. (這場意外的選舉勝利讓該黨在國會取得明顯多數。)

meaning: n. 偉大勝利；非凡的成功 v. 獲得勝利
example: The new bridge was widely seen as a major triumph of modern engineering and design. (這座新橋被普遍視為現代工程與設計的一大勝利。)

meaning: n. 紀念碑；歷史古蹟；典範

She won a silver medal in the 800 metres at the age of nineteen. (她十九歲時在八百公尺賽跑贏得銀牌。)

meaning: n. 尊敬；敬意；榮譽 v. 尊敬；給予表揚
example: The school held a special ceremony to honour the teachers who retired that year. (學校舉辦特別典禮，表揚那年退休的教師。)

meaning: n. 巡邏；巡查 v. 巡邏；巡查
example: Security guards patrol the whole building site every two hours, day and night. (保全人員日日夜夜每兩小時巡邏整個建築工地。)

meaning: n. 衛兵；警衛員 v. 看守；守衛；保衛
example: A security guard checked our passes carefully before allowing us through the gate. (警衛仔細檢查我們的通行證後，才讓我們通過大門。)

meaning: n. 間諜；特務 v. 收集情報；從事間諜活動

The young soldier finally returned home after more than two years of service abroad. (這名年輕士兵在國外服役兩年多後，終於返鄉。)
The elderly war veteran described his experiences calmly to a group of school students. (這位年長的退伍老兵平靜地向一群學生描述自己的經歷。)
She was an early pioneer of modern medical research into tropical diseases in Africa. (她是非洲熱帶疾病現代醫學研究的早期先驅。)
The ancient prophet warned the villagers that a long and severe drought was coming. (古代先知警告村民，一場漫長而嚴重的乾旱即將來臨。)

meaning: n. 使者；傳令官；先驅；預兆 v. 預告；宣佈
example: The first flowers of spring herald the end of a long, cold winter. (初春的花朵預告漫長寒冬即將結束。)

meaning: n. 接替者；繼任者；後繼的事物
example: The company has still not named a permanent successor to its retiring finance director. (這家公司仍未指派出任財務董事的正式繼任者。)
The younger generation now spends far more time online than their parents did at the same age. (年輕一代現在上網的時間，遠比他們的父母在同年紀時多得多。)

meaning: n. 姓；姓氏 v. 給……起別名
example: Please write your surname in capital letters at the top of the form. (請用大寫字母把姓氏寫在表格上方。)

Her husband works as a civil engineer at a company outside the city. (她丈夫在城外一家公司擔任土木工程師。)

meaning: n. 同性戀者（尤指男性） adj. 同性戀的；快樂的；豔麗的
example: The festival welcomes gay, lesbian and transgender visitors from all over the country. (這個節慶歡迎來自全國各地的男同志、女同志和跨性別訪客。)
My grandfather taught me how to grow vegetables in his garden without using chemicals. (我祖父教我如何在他的花園裡不用化學藥劑種菜。)
Her father-in-law still runs a small family furniture business in a northern town. (她的岳父仍在北部一座小鎮經營小型家族家具生意。)
Children who have older siblings often learn to read before they start primary school. (有哥哥姊姊的孩子常在進小學前就學會閱讀。)

meaning: n. 堂（或表）兄弟姊妹；表親
example: My favourite cousin lives in Canada and usually visits us during every second long summer holiday. (我最要好的表親住在加拿大，通常每隔一個長暑假會來看我們。)
My young nephew is learning to play the violin and practises it for an hour every evening. (我年幼的外甥正在學小提琴，每晚練一小時。)
My niece drew a picture of the whole family and gave it to me. (我姪女畫了一張全家福，送給我。)

meaning: adj. 成雙的 n. 雙胞胎之一
example: Her twin sister lives in the same street and they meet for coffee almost every day. (她的雙胞胎姊妹住在同一條街，兩人幾乎每天一起喝咖啡。)

meaning: n. 嬰兒；幼兒 adj. 嬰兒的；供嬰兒用的
example: An infant should be breastfed or given formula milk for the first months. (嬰兒在最初幾個月應以母乳或配方奶餵養。)

meaning: n. 孤兒 v. 使成為孤兒
example: The charity runs a small school for children who were orphaned by the long war. (這個慈善機構為因長期戰爭而成為孤兒的孩子辦了一所小學校。)
The club offers free weekly coaching to local youngsters who want to try track and field athletics. (這個俱樂部每週免費指導想嘗試田徑運動的當地年輕人。)

meaning: n. 青年時期；青春；青年
example: In his youth, he travelled across Europe by train with very little money. (他青年時期帶著很少的錢，搭火車遊遍歐洲。)

meaning: n. （13 至 19 歲之間的）青少年
example: Many teenagers spend several hours a day looking at screens for entertainment rather than study. (許多青少年每天花好幾小時看螢幕娛樂，而不是讀書。)

meaning: n. 家屬；親戚 adj. 有血緣關係的；類似的
example: The family invited all its closest kin to the traditional village wedding in June. (這家人邀請所有最親近的親戚參加六月的傳統鄉村婚禮。)
Older folk in the village still remember when the river froze over every single winter. (村裡的長輩仍記得從前那條河每年冬天都會結冰。)

meaning: adj. 親愛的；珍貴的 int. 啊呀
example: She wrote a long handwritten letter to her dear old friend who lives in Australia. (她寫了一封長長的手寫信，給住在澳洲的摯友。)
He called his youngest daughter darling and kissed her forehead softly before she left. (他喚小女兒「親愛的」，並在她離開前輕輕吻了她的額頭。)

meaning: n. 愛好者；（婚外的）情人
example: She is a great lover of classical music and attends concerts every month. (她非常熱愛古典音樂，每個月都去聽音樂會。)

meaning: n. 愛人 adj. 深受喜愛的
example: The beloved old teacher finally retired after almost forty years at the same village school. (這位深受喜愛的老教師在同一所鄉村學校任教近四十年後終於退休。)
The shop assistant asked, 'Can I help you, madam?' in a polite voice. (店員禮貌地問：「女士，需要我為您服務嗎？」)
The hostess greeted each guest warmly at the door and took their coats and bags. (女主人在門口親切迎接每位客人，並接過他們的外套和袋子。)
The elderly landlady lives downstairs and keeps the shared back garden tidy all year round. (年長的女房東住在樓下，全年把共用的後花園整理得很整齊。)
The novel's central character is the secret mistress of a wealthy nineteenth-century country landowner. (這本小說的主角是一位十九世紀鄉間富有地主秘密的情婦。)
The survey found that many housewives also do a great deal of unpaid care work. (這項調查發現，許多家庭主婦還承擔大量無酬照顧工作。)
The widow has lived alone in the small cottage since her husband died ten years ago. (丈夫十年前過世後，這位寡婦就獨自住在小屋裡。)
A maid cleans the hotel rooms every morning and changes every set of bed sheets. (女僕每天早上打掃飯店房間，並更換每一套床單。)
In the story, a young maiden waits by the river for her lover. (故事中，一位少女在河邊等待她的情人。)

meaning: n. 家庭雜務；乏味無聊的工作
example: Washing the dishes is a boring daily chore that nobody in the shared flat enjoys. (洗碗是件無聊的日常家務，合租公寓裡沒有人喜歡做。)

meaning: n. 地主；房東；（酒吧）店主
example: The landlord promised to repair the heating before the end of the month. (房東承諾在月底前修好暖氣。)
Each wedding guest received a small gift and a detailed map of the old city. (每位婚禮賓客都收到一份小禮物和一份老城詳細地圖。)
One angry customer complained again that the delivery had arrived three full days late. (一位氣憤的顧客再次抱怨，貨物整整遲了三天才送到。)

meaning: v. 想念；錯過；未注意到
example: I really miss my old school friends, although we still talk online almost every week. (我很想念以前學校的朋友，雖然我們幾乎每週都還會在線上聊天。)
Some older people may become dependent on daily help with cooking, cleaning and shopping. (有些年長者可能變得需要每天有人在煮飯、打掃和採買上幫忙。)
They quietly announced their engagement at a large family dinner in the country last Saturday. (他們上星期六在鄉間一場大型家庭晚餐中低調宣布訂婚。)
They plan to marry next spring in the village where they met. (他們打算明年春天在相識的村莊結婚。)
The wedding was small, with only close family and a few old friends. (婚禮規模不大，只有至親和幾位老朋友參加。)
They spent their honeymoon walking in the mountains and visiting small villages along the coast. (他們蜜月時在山間健行，並造訪沿海的小村落。)

meaning: v. 吻；接吻 n. 吻
example: She kissed her young son goodbye and watched him board the crowded evening train. (她吻別年幼的兒子，看著他搭上擁擠的晚班火車。)

meaning: n. 離婚；脫離 v. 與……離婚；使脫離
example: They finally decided to divorce legally after living apart for more than a year. (分居一年多後，他們終於決定循法律途徑離婚。)
The small flat is designed for a single person or a young couple. (這間小公寓是為單身者或年輕夫妻設計的。)
After the long meeting, the two managers returned quietly to their own respective regional offices. (冗長的會議結束後，兩位經理各自安靜地回到自己的地區辦公室。)
Each of the students received a certificate at the end of the course. (課程結束時，每位學生都拿到一張證書。)
The new express bus route has significantly cut journey times for thousands of daily commuters. (新的快速公車路線大幅縮短了數千名每日通勤者的旅程時間。)

meaning: n. 街坊；居住區；周邊地區
example: The quiet neighborhood has a small park, a public library and two primary schools. (這個安靜的居住區有一座小公園、一間公共圖書館和兩所小學。)
Each member of the small research team contributed useful ideas to the final plan. (小型研究團隊的每位成員都為最終計畫貢獻了有用的想法。)

meaning: n. 老闆；上司 v. 對……指手畫腳
example: Her boss agreed to let her work from home two days a week. (她的老闆同意讓她每週有兩天在家工作。)
The store manager explained the new safety procedure to staff at the morning meeting. (店經理在早會上向員工說明新的安全程序。)
She started the small design business with a partner she had met at university. (她和大學認識的合夥人一起創立了這家小型設計公司。)
A colleague recommended the new Italian restaurant, so we booked a table there. (同事推薦了那家新開的義大利餐廳，所以我們在那裡訂了位。)

meaning: n. 同志；（尤指共患難的）同伴
example: He wrote warmly about the comrades he had fought beside during the war. (他溫暖地寫下戰時與他並肩作戰的同伴。)
Their friendship began at school and has lasted for more than thirty years. (他們的友誼從學校開始，持續了三十多年。)
She looked at the old photographs with obvious affection and a little sadness. (她帶著明顯的喜愛和一點感傷，看著那些老照片。)
A stranger stopped me in the street and asked for directions to the station. (一名陌生人在街上攔住我，問我車站怎麼走。)

meaning: n. 學徒；徒弟 v. 使當……的學徒
example: The young apprentice learns the trade by working each day beside an experienced craftsman. (年輕學徒每天在經驗豐富的工匠身旁工作，學習這門手藝。)
The firefighter was praised as a hero for rescuing two children from the building. (這名消防員因從建築物中救出兩名孩童而被譽為英雄。)
The heroine of the novel leaves her village to study medicine in the city. (這本小說的女主角離開村莊，到城市學醫。)
The actress has won several major awards for her roles in independent films. (這位女演員因在獨立電影中的角色贏得數項大獎。)
The commander quietly ordered his exhausted troops to withdraw from the town before nightfall. (指揮官悄悄下令，要精疲力竭的部隊在入夜前撤出這座城鎮。)
The finance director of the company announced her retirement at the annual meeting. (公司的財務主管在年度會議上宣布退休。)
She is a strong proponent of free public transport for students and older people. (她強力支持學生和年長者免費搭乘公共運輸。)

meaning: n. 顧問；輔導顧問；（美國的）律師
example: The school counsellor helps students manage exam stress and make decisions about their future. (學校輔導顧問協助學生處理考試壓力，並為未來做決定。)
The defence attorney advised her client to say nothing at all until the morning hearing began. (辯護律師建議她的當事人在上午的聽證會開始前完全不要發言。)
The umpire stopped the tennis match when the rain became far too heavy to play in. (雨勢大到無法比賽時，裁判中止了這場網球賽。)
The cashier carefully counted the large notes twice before handing over the correct change. (收銀員仔細數了兩次大鈔，才把正確的零錢遞出去。)
A fireman carefully carried the frightened child down the ladder and out of the smoke. (一名消防員小心地把受驚的孩子抱下梯子，帶離濃煙。)

meaning: n. 護士；保姆 v. 照料；餵奶
example: A nurse checked his blood pressure and calmly explained what would happen next. (護士為他量血壓，並平靜地說明接下來會怎麼做。)
The head gardener plants native flowers that attract bees and butterflies throughout the long, dry summer. (園藝主管種植原生花卉，在漫長乾燥的夏季吸引蜜蜂和蝴蝶。)
The old barber asked politely how short I wanted him to cut my hair this time. (老理髮師禮貌地問我這次想把頭髮剪多短。)
He gets a haircut every six weeks and always goes to the same shop. (他每六週理一次髮，而且總是去同一家店。)
The old fisherman repaired his torn nets carefully before leaving the harbour at first light. (老漁夫在破曉離港前，仔細修補破掉的漁網。)
The local butcher cut the meat into thin slices and wrapped it carefully in paper. (當地肉販把肉切成薄片，仔細用紙包好。)

meaning: n. 新郎；馬伕 v. （給動物）刷洗；理毛
example: The young groom stood waiting alone and nervously at the front of the small village church. (年輕新郎獨自緊張地站在小村莊教堂前方等待。)
The bank staff were held hostage inside the building for several hours before police arrived. (銀行員工被挾持在建築物內好幾個小時，警方才趕到。)

meaning: n. 苦工；苦活 v. 辛勤勞作；苦幹
example: Farmers toil from dawn to dusk in the flooded rice fields during the busy harvest season. (農民在忙碌的收成季節從早到晚在淹水的稻田裡辛勤勞作。)
A beggar sat outside the station with a cup and a thin blanket. (一名乞丐坐在車站外，身邊放著一個杯子和一條薄毯。)
The slaves on the cotton plantation were finally freed at the end of the long civil war. (長達多年的內戰結束後，棉花園裡的奴隸終於獲得自由。)
He was unfairly called a coward for refusing to join the others in the fighting. (他因拒絕和其他人一起投入戰鬥，而被不公平地稱為懦夫。)

meaning: v. 行動；表演 n. 行為；法案
example: The government must now act quickly to reduce harmful air pollution in the largest cities. (政府現在必須迅速行動，減少大城市的有害空氣汙染。)
She was widely praised for her many quiet good deeds within the small local community. (她因在當地小社區裡默默做了許多善事而廣受讚揚。)
How people react to public criticism often depends on the way the criticism is expressed. (人們如何回應公開批評，往往取決於批評表達的方式。)
The still lake reflects the snowy mountains so clearly that it looks like a giant mirror. (平靜的湖面清晰映出雪山，看起來就像一面巨大的鏡子。)

meaning: v. 割；修剪 n. 乾草堆
example: He mows the front lawn every Saturday morning from early April to late October. (從四月初到十月底，他每個星期六早上都會修剪前院草坪。)

meaning: v. 支撐；支援；供養 n. 支援；幫助
example: The new local scheme supports families who are caring full-time for frail elderly relatives at home. (這項新的地方方案支援在家全職照顧孱弱年長親屬的家庭。)

meaning: v. 怒目而視；發出強光 n. 刺眼的光；怒視
example: The sun glared off the wet road, making it very hard for drivers to see. (陽光在溼滑路面上發出刺眼反光，讓駕駛很難看清路況。)

meaning: v. 瞥；迅速看一眼 n. 一瞥
example: She glanced nervously at her watch and then hurried towards the small crowded meeting room. (她緊張地瞥了一眼手錶，然後趕往那間擁擠的小會議室。)

meaning: v. 窺視；偷看 n. 偷偷一瞥
example: The child peeped through the curtains to see who was at the door. (孩子從窗簾縫隙偷看，想知道門口是誰。)
He gazed at the large painting for several minutes without saying a single word. (他凝視那幅大畫好幾分鐘，一句話也沒說。)

meaning: v. 凝視；盯著看 n. 同輩；同等地位的人
example: She peered through the fog, trying to find the edge of the road. (她透過濃霧使勁看，想找出路的邊緣。)

meaning: n. 誓約；誓言 v. 發誓
example: They vowed to remain close friends even after they finally separated and moved to different cities. (他們發誓即使最後分開、各自搬到不同城市，仍要當好朋友。)
All witnesses must take a formal oath to tell the truth in open court. (所有證人都必須在公開法庭上正式宣誓說真話。)

meaning: v. 回答；答覆 n. 回答；答覆
example: She did not reply to the email until the following Monday morning. (她一直到隔週一早上才回覆那封電子郵件。)
The teacher explained the task twice, but some students still looked confused. (老師解釋了兩次任務內容，但有些學生看起來仍一頭霧水。)

meaning: v. 吵架；爭論 n. 爭吵；爭論
example: The two brothers quarrelled over money and did not speak to each other for many months. (兩兄弟為了錢吵架，之後好幾個月不跟對方說話。)

meaning: v. 趕緊；催促 n. 匆忙
example: There is no need to hurry, because the train leaves in an hour. (不必趕，因為火車還要一小時才開。)
The recent financial scandal may quite possibly hasten the minister's departure from public office. (最近的財務醜聞很可能促使這位部長提早離開公職。)
His mother scolded him for arriving home so late without calling or sending a message. (他媽媽責罵他這麼晚回家，卻沒先打電話或傳訊息。)

meaning: v. 詛咒；咒罵 n. 咒語；咒罵
example: The old man cursed loudly when his car refused to start yet again. (車子又發不動時，那位老先生大聲咒罵。)
The sudden decision to close the factory provoked widespread anger among local workers. (突然決定關閉工廠，引發當地工人的普遍憤怒。)
The old priest preached about forgiveness and the importance of helping poor families nearby. (老神父佈道談寬恕，以及幫助附近貧困家庭的重要性。)

meaning: v. 觸摸；觸動 n. 觸覺；接觸
example: The story touched everyone in the room, and several people began to cry. (這個故事觸動了房裡每一個人，好幾個人開始落淚。)

meaning: v. 拍手；輕拍 n. 鼓掌；拍手聲
example: The audience clapped loudly while standing for several minutes after the final performance ended. (最後一場演出結束後，觀眾起立熱烈鼓掌好幾分鐘。)
She ran to catch the bus but reached the stop just too late. (她跑去趕公車，但到站時剛好太遲了。)

meaning: v. 一把抓住；迅速奪取
example: A thief on a motorbike snatched her handbag and disappeared into the crowd. (一名騎機車的竊賊一把搶走她的手提包，消失在人群中。)

meaning: v. 追上；超過；（情感）壓倒
example: It is dangerous to overtake on this narrow road with so many bends. (在這條彎道很多的窄路上超車很危險。)

meaning: v. 跟隨；遵循；是……的必然結果
example: He followed the written instructions carefully but still could not assemble the wooden shelf. (他仔細照著書面說明做，卻還是組裝不好那個木架。)
First loosen the two screws carefully before you try to remove the plastic back cover. (先小心鬆開兩顆螺絲，再試著拆下塑膠背蓋。)

meaning: v. 打碎；（使）猛烈撞擊；（打球時）扣球
example: A cricket ball smashed through the kitchen window and landed on the tiled floor. (一顆板球擊碎廚房窗戶，掉在磁磚地板上。)
She wiped the table with a damp cloth and set out the plates. (她用溼布擦桌子，然後擺好盤子。)
The tall branches swayed in the strong wind, scattering dry leaves across the garden path. (高處的樹枝在強風中搖擺，把乾葉散落在花園小徑上。)

meaning: v. 搖動；（使）顫動 n. 搖動；顫動
example: You should always shake the medicine bottle well before opening it at home. (在家打開藥瓶前，一定要先充分搖勻。)
The young dancers whirled around the crowded hall to the fast and lively music. (年輕舞者在擁擠的大廳裡隨著快速活潑的音樂迴旋起舞。)

meaning: v. 洗（牌）；拖著腳走；打亂次序 n. 洗牌
example: He shuffled the worn cards twice and then dealt five cards to each player. (他把磨舊的牌洗了兩次，然後給每位玩家發五張牌。)
Two large cars collided at the busy junction because neither driver would slow down. (兩輛大車在繁忙路口相撞，因為兩名駕駛都不肯減速。)

meaning: v. 刺入；穿透；滲透；洞察
example: The knife penetrated the thick leather but did not reach the skin. (刀子穿透厚皮革，但沒有傷到皮膚。)

meaning: v. 刺穿；刺破；穿透；使心如刀割
example: The thin needle pierced the skin quickly, and she hardly felt any pain at all. (細針很快刺穿皮膚，她幾乎完全沒感覺到痛。)

meaning: v. 拖；拉；牽引 n. 牽引
example: The truck towed the broken car to a garage ten miles away. (拖車把故障的車拖到十英里外的修車廠。)

meaning: v. （使）拖在後面 n. 蹤跡；小徑
example: Long white ribbons trailed from the bride's dark hair as she walked down the aisle. (新娘走過紅毯時，長長的白緞帶從她的深色頭髮垂落。)
The old priest quietly baptized the baby in the small stone church beside the river. (老神父在河邊的小石造教堂裡，安靜地為嬰兒施行洗禮。)

meaning: v. 使痴迷；使心神不寧
example: He is obsessed with details and often works late to perfect his reports. (他對細節非常執著，常加班把報告改到完美。)
The children were completely mesmerized by the lights and music of the performance. (孩子們完全被表演的燈光和音樂迷住了。)

meaning: v. 感到驚訝；大為讚歎 n. 奇蹟
example: Visitors still marvel at the sheer size and detail of the ancient stone temple. (遊客至今仍對這座古代石造神廟的龐大規模和細節讚歎不已。)

meaning: v. 劫持（飛機或其他交通工具）

meaning: v. 定罪；宣判……有罪 n. 已決犯

meaning: v. 使上當；激怒 n. 誘餌；誘惑物

meaning: v. 派遣；調派；迅速處理

meaning: v. 掩飾；假扮；偽裝 n. 假扮；偽裝物

meaning: v. 想要；希望 n. 希望；願望

meaning: v. 發癢；渴望 n. 癢；渴望

meaning: v. 履行；實現；完成；滿足

meaning: n. 種類；類別 v. 把……分類

meaning: adj. 清晰的；明顯的 v. 清除；清空

meaning: n. 提議；出價 v. 提供；出（價）

meaning: v. 原諒；同意免除 n. 理由；藉口

meaning: n. 尊重；問候 v. 看待；視為

meaning: n. 崇拜；禮拜；愛慕 v. 做禮拜；崇拜

meaning: v. （使）落下；（使）降低；斷絕關係 n. 滴

meaning: v. 垂直掉下；（價格或水平等）驟然下跌

meaning: int. 歡迎 n. 歡迎 v. 歡迎

meaning: v. 向……問好；迎接；對……做出反應

meaning: v. 重複；重說 adj. 再次光顧的

meaning: v. （使）傾向於；傾斜 n. 斜坡；傾斜

meaning: v. （使）倚靠；傾斜 adj. 瘦的；貧乏的

meaning: n. 舉止；禮貌；風俗；方式

meaning: adj. 人類的；有人性的 n. 人類

meaning: n. 嘴唇；（洞口或傷口等的）邊緣

meaning: n. 手掌；棕櫚樹 v. 把……藏在手中

meaning: n. 大腿部；膝上；下襬；一圈

meaning: n. 毛孔；小孔；氣孔 v. 凝視；沉思

meaning: n. 心臟病發作；心肌梗塞

meaning: adj. 卓越的；引起敬畏的
example: The engineers built an awesome bridge that crosses the valley in a single span. (工程師建造了一座卓越的橋，以單一跨距橫越山谷。)

meaning: adj. 辛勤的；費力的；陡峭的
example: The arduous climb took six hours and left the walkers completely exhausted. (那趟費力的攀登花了六小時，讓健行者完全累垮。)
You need a sturdy pair of boots for walking on these rocky paths. (在這些多岩石的路上行走，你需要一雙強健的靴子。)
She remained steadfast in her support for the project despite the criticism. (儘管受到批評，她仍堅定支持這項計畫。)

meaning: adj. （氣候）溫和的；溫帶的；有節制的；心平氣和的
example: The island has a temperate climate, with mild winters and warm but not hot summers. (這座島氣候溫和，冬天不冷，夏天溫暖但不炎熱。)
His childish reaction to the criticism surprised everyone at the meeting on Monday. (他對批評的幼稚反應，讓星期一會議上的所有人都很訝異。)

meaning: adj. 有責任的；有……傾向的；可能的
example: Drivers who ignore the speed limit are liable to cause serious accidents. (忽視速限的駕駛容易造成嚴重事故。)

meaning: adj. 有事業心的；有進取心的；有魄力的
example: An enterprising student started a repair service for old bicycles in the town. (一位有事業心的學生在鎮上開創了舊腳踏車維修服務。)

meaning: adj. 心智健全的；理智的
example: It is hard to stay sane when traffic noise continues all through the night. (交通噪音整夜不停時，很難保持心智健全。)

meaning: adj. 發奮的；繁重的；艱苦的
example: The doctor advised him to avoid strenuous exercise for at least six weeks. (醫師建議他至少六週內避免繁重的運動。)
The school has strict rules about mobile phones during lessons and examinations. (學校對上課和考試期間使用手機有嚴格規定。)
The two plans are similar in cost but differ in the number of parking spaces. (這兩項計畫成本相似，但停車位數量不同。)
Her voice sounded familiar, but I could not remember where we had met. (她的聲音聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起我們在哪裡見過。)
Her intuition told her to check the figures again before sending the report. (她的直覺告訴她，寄出報告前要再檢查一次數字。)

meaning: adj. 自發的；自然的；本能的
example: The crowd broke into spontaneous applause when the singer appeared on stage. (歌手登台時，群眾自發地熱烈鼓掌。)

meaning: adj. 暗示的；含蓄的；不懷疑的
example: There was an implicit warning in his tone when he mentioned the deadline. (他提到截止期限時，語氣裡帶著含蓄的警告。)
The child described an imaginary friend who lived under the garden shed. (孩子描述一個住在花園工具棚下的想像朋友。)
He made his fortune in software and later gave much of it away. (他靠軟體賺了財產，後來把大部分捐出去。)
The injury caused him agony until the ambulance arrived twenty minutes later. (傷勢讓他極度痛苦，直到二十分鐘後救護車抵達。)
Her grief after the loss of her father lasted for many months. (父親過世後，她的極度悲傷持續了好幾個月。)

meaning: n. 悲痛；窮困；不幸 v. 使傷心；使憂慮
example: The news of the accident caused great distress to the whole village. (事故的消息為整個村莊帶來極大的悲痛。)
A deep sadness filled the room when the old teacher's retirement was announced. (老教師退休的消息宣布時，一股深沉的悲傷充滿整個房間。)

meaning: adj. 幽暗的；令人沮喪的
example: The gloomy corridor was lit by a single window at the far end. (幽暗的走廊只靠最盡頭的一扇窗照明。)
The delayed train disappointed thousands of passengers who had planned to travel. (誤點的火車讓數千名原定出遊的乘客很失望。)

meaning: adj. 不幸的；可憐的；悲慘的；惡劣的
example: The wretched family lost their home in the flood and needed urgent help. (那個不幸的家庭在洪水中失去家園，急需幫助。)
The town gathered to mourn the death of the much-loved local doctor. (全鎮聚集起來，哀悼深受愛戴的當地醫師。)

meaning: n. 怒；怒氣 v. 使發怒
example: His anger rose when he saw the damage to his parked car. (看到停著的車被破壞時，他的怒氣升了上來。)

meaning: n. 盛怒；狂怒 v. 發怒；肆虐
example: She could not hide her rage when the company refused to answer her letters. (公司拒絕回覆她的信件時，她掩不住盛怒。)
I hate waiting in long queues at the airport after a tiring flight. (我討厭在疲累的飛行後，還要在機場排長隊等待。)
Years of unfair treatment had turned their simple disagreement into deep personal hatred. (多年的不公平對待，把他們單純的意見不合變成深深的憎恨。)

meaning: n. 討厭的人或物；麻煩事
example: The constant noise from the building site has become a real nuisance. (建築工地不斷傳來的噪音，已經成為真正的麻煩事。)

meaning: v. 使厭惡；使作嘔 n. 厭惡；嫌惡
example: She looked at the dirty kitchen with obvious disgust and called the manager. (她帶著明顯的厭惡看著髒亂的廚房，然後打電話給經理。)
The repeated delays at the station began to vex even patient commuters. (車站反覆的延誤開始讓甚至有耐心的通勤族也感到煩惱。)
The new law protects workers who are harassed by customers or colleagues. (新法律保護遭顧客或同事騷擾的員工。)

meaning: adj. 令人煩惱的；麻煩的
example: The troublesome cough kept her awake for most of the cold winter night. (那惱人的咳嗽讓她整個寒冷的冬夜大部分時間都醒著。)

meaning: adj. 令人不愉快的；討厭的
example: There was an unpleasant smell in the lift, so we used the stairs. (電梯裡有一股令人不愉快的味道，所以我們走樓梯。)
She was indignant when the shop refused to replace the faulty machine. (店家拒絕更換故障的機器時，她感到很憤慨。)
The report recommends radical changes to the way the city manages waste. (這份報告建議對城市的廢棄物管理方式做出激進的改變。)
The noise from the machines was so loud that it nearly drove him mad. (機器發出的噪音太大，幾乎把他逼瘋。)
It seems crazy to drive across the city during the morning rush hour. (在早上尖峰時間開車橫越市區，似乎很瘋狂。)
The wicked stepmother in the story tries to keep the sisters apart. (故事裡邪惡的繼母想辦法讓姊妹們分開。)
His ego was hurt when the committee chose a younger candidate for the post. (委員會選了較年輕的候選人擔任這個職位時，他的自尊受傷了。)

meaning: adj. 自私的；利己主義的
example: It was selfish of him to take the last seat without asking anyone. (他沒問任何人就佔了最後一個座位，實在很自私。)
It was a rash decision to buy the car without checking its history. (沒查過車子的來歷就買下它，是草率的決定。)

meaning: adj. 易變的；反覆無常的；易揮發的
example: Food prices are volatile and can rise sharply after a poor harvest. (糧食價格易變，收成不好之後可能急遽上漲。)
A weird sound came from the attic, so we called an electrician. (閣樓傳來奇怪的聲音，所以我們打電話請電工來。)
Her anxiety about the exam made it difficult to sleep the night before. (她對考試的焦慮，讓她在考前一晚很難入睡。)

meaning: adj. 不安定的；焦躁不安的；不耐煩的
example: The children grew restless during the long wait at the railway station. (在火車站長時間等待時，孩子們變得焦躁不安。)

meaning: n. 害怕；擔心 v. 害怕；擔心
example: Many people have a fear of speaking in front of a large audience. (許多人害怕在大批觀眾面前說話。)
There was a great fuss when the celebrity arrived at the small café. (那位名人來到這家小咖啡館時，引起一陣大驚小怪。)

meaning: v. 侮辱；凌辱 n. 侮辱；凌辱
example: He did not mean to insult the host when he refused the second helping. (他拒絕再添一份時，並不是有意侮辱主人。)

meaning: adj. 不和善的；不仁慈的；刻薄的
example: It was unkind to laugh at the new student's pronunciation during the lesson. (上課時嘲笑新生的發音，是很刻薄的行為。)

meaning: n. 羨慕；嫉妒 v. 羨慕；嫉妒
example: Her envy of her colleague's promotion made it hard to work together. (她羨慕同事升遷，讓兩人很難共事。)

meaning: n. 懷疑；疑問 v. 懷疑；不信
example: There is some doubt about whether the bridge will be finished this year. (這座橋今年能否完工，還有一些懷疑。)
The police treated the damaged car with suspicion and took photographs of every mark. (警方對那輛受損的車抱持懷疑，並拍下每道痕跡。)
Many local residents remain skeptical about the council's plan to reduce city traffic. (許多當地居民仍對市議會減少市區車流的計畫持懷疑態度。)

meaning: adj. 不穩定的；易變的；不牢固的
example: The old wall looks unstable, so the council has closed the path. (那道舊牆看起來不穩定，所以市議會已經封閉這條小路。)

meaning: adj. 不合適的；不適宜的
example: This film is unsuitable for young children because of its violent scenes. (這部電影有暴力場面，不適合幼童觀看。)

meaning: adj. 不願意的；不情願的；勉強的
example: He was unwilling to move abroad, although the salary was much higher. (雖然薪水高得多，他仍不願意搬到國外。)

meaning: v. 使尷尬；使窘迫；使侷促不安
example: Please do not embarrass the speaker by asking questions she cannot answer. (請不要問講者她答不出來的問題，讓她尷尬。)

meaning: n. 遺憾；抱歉；悲嘆 v. 後悔；痛惜；惋惜
example: Her only regret was that she had not visited her grandmother more often. (她唯一的遺憾是沒有更常去看祖母。)
The prisoner said he had come to repent and to apologise to the family. (那名囚犯說他來懺悔，並向那家人道歉。)

meaning: adj. 慚愧的；感到難為情的
example: He felt ashamed of his behaviour at the party and wrote a letter of apology. (他為自己在派對上的行為感到慚愧，寫了一封道歉信。)

meaning: n. 嘆息；嘆氣 v. 嘆息；嘆氣
example: With a deep sigh, she closed the book and turned off the lamp. (她深深嘆了一口氣，闔上書，關掉檯燈。)

meaning: v. 哭泣；流淚；哀悼 n. 哭泣
example: She began to weep when she heard that the old theatre would be demolished. (她聽到老劇院將被拆除時，開始哭泣。)
The city is known for its tolerance of different religions and lifestyles. (這座城市以容忍不同宗教和生活方式聞名。)
He gave a sly smile and refused to tell us where the keys were. (他狡猾地笑了一下，不肯告訴我們鑰匙在哪裡。)
The cunning fox waited until the farmer had left the hen house. (狡猾的狐狸一直等到農夫離開雞舍。)

meaning: adj. 武斷的；專斷的；任意的
example: The decision seemed arbitrary, as nobody explained why the application was refused. (這個決定顯得武斷，因為沒有人說明申請為何被拒絕。)

meaning: adj. 愚蠢的；乏味的 n. 傻瓜；笨蛋
example: It was stupid to leave the windows open during the storm last night. (昨晚暴風雨時還把窗戶開著，實在很愚蠢。)

meaning: adj. 笨拙的；尷尬的；棘手的；不合適的
example: There was an awkward silence after he mentioned the manager's earlier mistake. (他提到經理先前的錯誤後，出現一陣尷尬的沉默。)

meaning: adj. 粗心的；無憂無慮的；淡漠的
example: A careless driver left the van blocking the entrance to the hospital. (一名粗心的駕駛把廂型車停在醫院入口，擋住通道。)

meaning: adj. 不知道的；未注意的
example: He was oblivious to the rain and kept working in the garden. (他沒注意到在下雨，繼續在花園裡工作。)
The naughty puppy chewed two pairs of shoes while nobody was watching. (那隻淘氣的小狗在沒人看的時候咬壞了兩雙鞋。)
The greedy landlord raised the rent twice in the same year without warning. (那個貪心的房東在同一年內無預警漲了兩次房租。)

meaning: adj. 過分炫耀的；過分突出的；扎眼的
example: The new sign is obtrusive and spoils the view of the old square. (新招牌過分突出，破壞了老廣場的景觀。)

meaning: adj. 行動遲緩的；緩慢的
example: The computer became sluggish after several programs were left running all day. (好幾個程式開了一整天之後，電腦變得行動遲緩。)
He is too stubborn to admit that the original plan was wrong. (他太頑固，不肯承認原本的計畫是錯的。)

meaning: n. 刻板印象；模式化觀念
example: The film challenges the stereotype of the quiet librarian who hates adventure. (這部電影挑戰「安靜的圖書館員討厭冒險」的刻板印象。)

meaning: adj. 每日的 n. 日報
example: Her daily walk to the office takes about twenty minutes each way. (她每天走路到辦公室，單程大約二十分鐘。)

meaning: adj. 每月的 adv. 每月一次 n. 月刊
example: The monthly meeting gives local residents a chance to raise concerns about transport. (每月的會議讓當地居民有機會提出交通方面的疑慮。)

meaning: adj. 季度的 adv. 按季度地 n. 季刊
example: The company publishes a quarterly report on its environmental performance and energy use. (公司每季發布一份環境績效與能源使用的報告。)

meaning: adj. 每年的 adv. 每年地
example: The yearly inspection ensures that the lifts in the building remain safe. (每年的檢查確保大樓裡的電梯保持安全。)

meaning: n. 週年紀念日；周年紀念
example: They returned to the same restaurant to celebrate their tenth wedding anniversary. (他們回到同一家餐廳慶祝結婚十週年紀念日。)

meaning: adj. 現在的；出席的 n. 目前；禮物
example: The present transport system cannot cope with the growing number of daily visitors. (現在的運輸系統無法應付日益增加的每日訪客。)
The new gallery displays contemporary art from several countries in Asia and Latin America. (新藝廊展出亞洲和拉丁美洲好幾個國家的當代藝術。)
The cathedral was built in the twelfth century and still holds daily services. (這座大教堂建於十二世紀，至今仍每天舉行禮拜。)
Nearly one million people visit the old city during the summer months. (夏季期間有將近百萬人參觀這座老城。)
The government plans to spend two billion dollars on new railway lines. (政府計畫在新建鐵路線上花費二十億元。)

meaning: n. 一打；十二個；十來個
example: She bought a dozen eggs and two loaves of bread at the market. (她在市場買了一打雞蛋和兩條麵包。)

meaning: n. 黎明；開端 v. 破曉
example: Fishermen leave the harbour at dawn and return before the afternoon tide. (漁民在黎明時離開港口，下午漲潮前回來。)
The streets are almost empty at midday because of the intense heat. (因為酷熱，正午時街道幾乎空無一人。)
The last bus leaves the station at midnight, so we must hurry. (最後一班公車午夜從車站開出，所以我們得快一點。)

meaning: adv. 在晚上；一夜之間；突然
example: The small fishing village became famous overnight after the film was released abroad. (那部電影在國外上映後，這座小漁村一夜之間出名。)
The temperature drops sharply at night in the desert, even during summer. (沙漠裡即使在夏天，夜間氣溫也會驟降。)
The hospital has modern equipment and a new unit for heart patients. (這家醫院有現代化的設備，還有一個新的心臟病人病房。)
A recent study found that young people sleep less than their parents did. (最近一項研究發現，年輕人睡得比父母那一輩少。)

meaning: num. 第一 adv. 最初；首先
example: She was the first person in her family to attend university abroad. (她是家裡第一個出國讀大學的人。)
Firstly, the cost is too high; secondly, the plan would harm local wildlife. (首先，成本太高；其次，這項計畫會傷害當地野生動物。)

meaning: adv. 最後；終於；決定性地
example: After three delays, the train finally arrived at the platform just after midnight. (經過三次延誤，火車終於在午夜過後抵達月台。)

meaning: v. 完成；結束 n. 結尾；最後部分
example: I need to finish the report before the meeting starts on Monday. (我需要在星期一會議開始前完成報告。)

meaning: n. 瞬間 adj. 立即的；即時的
example: For a brief instant, the whole room went silent after the surprising announcement. (宣布那個令人意外的消息後，整個房間有一瞬間陷入沉默。)
Please wait a moment while I find the correct file for your application. (請等一下，我幫你找正確的申請文件。)

meaning: n. 分；分鐘；一會兒 adj. 細微的
example: Wait a minute, the express train to the airport does not leave until ten. (等一下，到機場的特快車十點才開。)
The preceding chapter explains how the survey data was collected and carefully analysed. (前一章說明了調查資料如何蒐集與仔細分析。)

meaning: adj. 開始的 n. 開始；開端；開口
example: Her opening remarks set a friendly tone for the whole two-day conference. (她的開場白為整個為期兩天的會議定下友善的調子。)
The parking scheme was initially unpopular, but most residents now support it strongly. (停車方案最初不受歡迎，但現在大多數居民強烈支持。)
The poem speaks of everlasting love that survives distance and the passing years. (這首詩談的是永恆的愛，能超越距離和流逝的歲月。)
The old bridge is inspected periodically to check for cracks, rust and loose bolts. (這座舊橋定期接受檢查，以查看裂縫、鏽蝕和鬆動的螺栓。)

meaning: adj. （尤指不愉快的事）即將發生的；逼近的
example: Dark clouds suggested that a heavy storm was imminent, so we went indoors. (烏雲顯示一場大雨即將來臨，所以我們進到室內。)

meaning: adv. 偶然地；順便提一句
example: The town library will close early on Friday, incidentally, for staff training. (順便提一句，鎮立圖書館星期五會提早關門，進行員工訓練。)
